walkthroughs.body_html:
Areas of Inquiry: Music Technology in the Electronic and Digital Age — a core area of Music.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Areas of Inquiry: Music Technology in the Electronic and Digital Age brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Areas of Inquiry: Music Technology in the Electronic and Digital Age.

mcqs.q: What three notes form a major triad in root position?
options: It is the very first section.
Root, major third, perfect fifth.
Three consecutive scale notes.
Any three notes played together.

mcqs.q: What is the function of the bridge in a pop song?
options: It is the very first section.
It is the same as the chorus.
Classical means any old serious music.
To provide contrast before the final chorus, often by changing melody, key, or texture.
